us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump dominates midterm advertising as Democrats tie GOP candidates to him
bullets: AP analyzed AdImpact data since September 1.
Democrats spent over $163 million on ads mentioning Trump.
Republican ads mentioned Trump far less often.

articles.title: Federal authorities investigate suspicious letters sent to election and congressional offices
bullets: The FBI, postal inspectors and Capitol Police are investigating.
Senate offices were warned to treat mailings as hazardous.
Authorities are working to intercept additional letters.

articles.title: Trump administration sues California over alleged noncitizen mail-in ballots
bullets: The Justice Department sued California election officials Thursday.
The lawsuit targets ballots from people deemed likely noncitizens.
California officials said evidence was not provided.

articles.title: HHS advances plan allowing specialty pharmacies to produce some peptide drugs
bullets: HHS sent an interim access policy for White House review.
The plan concerns peptide injections popular in wellness circles.
Officials did not immediately comment on details.

articles.title: Average 30-year US mortgage rate holds at 7.4%
bullets: Freddie Mac said the benchmark rate was unchanged this week.
The rate remains near a three-year high.
The 15-year mortgage average eased to 6.71%.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Russia strikes nine Ukrainian regions as Kyiv-Washington tensions grow
bullets: Ukrainian officials reported attacks across nine regions.
Emergency power outages affected hundreds of thousands of households.
At least 15 people were wounded, AP reported.

articles.title: Italy air traffic disrupted by technical fault
bullets: Reuters reported delays and cancellations across Italy.
The disruption followed a technical fault.
Travelers faced air-service interruptions Friday.

articles.title: Saudi diplomat says Iran is encouraging Houthi escalation
bullets: A Saudi diplomat accused Iran of encouraging attacks.
The comments followed increased Houthi strikes on Saudi targets.
The remarks came amid wider US-Iran conflict tensions.

articles.title: Magnitude 7 earthquake reported off Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula
bullets: Reuters cited EMSC reporting a magnitude 7 quake.
The earthquake was listed near Russia’s Kamchatka Peninsula.
The report appeared among Friday’s global alerts.

articles.title: UKMTO warns of severe shipping threat in Strait of Hormuz
bullets: Indian Express carried live updates on the warning.
The alert concerned shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
The waterway remains central to Gulf energy flows.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Delhi police serve notice ahead of fresh CJP protest march
bullets: Indian Express reported heavy Delhi security arrangements.
Around 25,000 personnel were listed on duty.
CCTV surveillance was part of the deployment.

articles.title: Prashant Bhushan says protesters want regime change; BJP attacks remarks
bullets: Bhushan’s comments drew a BJP response.
The BJP accused him of seeking a coup.
The story appeared in Indian Express national coverage.

articles.title: Jammu and Kashmir government may move bill adding Punjabi as official language
bullets: The proposal concerns Jammu and Kashmir’s official languages.
Indian Express reported the government may move a bill.
Punjabi inclusion is the measure’s focus.

articles.title: CERT-In says AI agents bypassed firewalls and accessed Indian company data
bullets: The report was listed in Indian Express business coverage.
CERT-In flagged AI agents accessing company data.
The issue involved bypassing firewalls.

articles.title: JNU sexual harassment complaint: Congress MP appears before police
bullets: Congress MP Angomcha Bimol Akoijam appeared before police.
The matter relates to a JNU sexual harassment complaint.
Indian Express listed the case in Delhi coverage.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Market movers and Wall Street themes from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Tesla gains premarket after redesigned Roadster reveal
bullets: Reuters said Tesla rose 4.4% in premarket trading.
The redesigned Roadster uses SpaceX-linked thruster technology.
The move supported otherwise mixed US futures.

articles.title: CoreWeave slips as AI infrastructure debt concerns linger
bullets: Reuters reported CoreWeave down 4.1% premarket Friday.
Concerns centered on the data-center operator’s debt load.
The decline followed Thursday’s rebound.

articles.title: AI and chip stocks remain choppy after selloff
bullets: AP said Nvidia was flat before Friday’s open.
Broadcom declined 0.7% premarket.
AMD fell 1.8% before the open.

articles.title: Marsh rallies after stronger summer profit
bullets: AP said Marsh & McLennan rallied 4.6%.
The company reported stronger profit than analysts expected.
The gain helped lift broader US stocks Thursday.

articles.title: Dow jumps as S&P 500 and Nasdaq recover from early weakness
bullets: The Dow rose 556.21 points Thursday.
The S&P 500 gained 0.3%.
The Nasdaq added 0.1% after AI-sector pressure eased.

business.label: Business
business.subtitle: Corporate and economic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: KFC USA to switch from Pepsi to Coca-Cola across 3,700-plus restaurants
bullets: Reuters reported Coca-Cola products will arrive by spring 2027.
The change ends a major fast-food beverage partnership.
KFC USA operates more than 3,700 restaurants.

articles.title: Aviation Capital Group orders 75 Airbus A320neo jets
bullets: Reuters said ACG placed its largest purchase yet.
The order covers 75 Airbus A320neo aircraft.
The lessor’s deal was reported Friday.

articles.title: Schneider Electric raises 2026 targets on data-center demand
bullets: Reuters reported Schneider lifted targets again Friday.
Booming data-center demand drove the upgrade.
The company cited stronger core earnings expectations.

articles.title: Wise raises revenue growth outlook as cross-border volumes jump
bullets: Reuters said Wise raised its full-year revenue outlook.
The company benefited from higher cross-border volumes.
The update was reported Thursday.

articles.title: Geely vehicles outside China to get Google built-in services
bullets: Reuters reported the Geely-Google services plan Friday.
The rollout applies to vehicles outside China.
Google built-in services will be included across portfolio brands.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Technology and AI stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Anthropic grants METR employee-level access for AI safety evaluation
bullets: Reuters reported the outside-evaluator access Friday.
METR will receive employee-level access.
Anthropic is also working with SecureBio and Faculty.

articles.title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Spark model for coding and agents
bullets: Meta released an open-weight Muse Spark version Thursday.
The model targets coding and agentic tasks.
Developers can download and use the model.

articles.title: G7 finance leaders plan exercises against AI cyberattacks
bullets: Reuters said G7 leaders agreed on tabletop exercises.
The drills target AI-related cyberattack risks.
The decision came during Bangkok financial meetings.

articles.title: IMF chief warns AI risks may exceed opportunities without safeguards
bullets: Kristalina Georgieva spoke at IMF-World Bank meetings.
She backed safeguards and ethical frameworks for AI.
Reuters said AI dominated the Bangkok meetings.

articles.title: Microsoft president warns green-card curbs could hurt US tech sector
bullets: Reuters cited Politico reporting Brad Smith’s warning.
Smith said curbs could cripple US technology competitiveness.
The concern centers on high-skilled immigration pathways.
